heard: Voyager 2 found an Earth-sized storm on distant Neptune. It was a massive anti-cyclone swirling in freezing darkness. Neptune gets only 3% of the sunlight Jupiter receives. Yet Voyager 2 imaged dark rings and unknown moons. It even caught active ice geysers erupting on Triton. Astronomers pointed the Hubble Space Telescope at Neptune in 1994. The Great Dark Spot had completely vanished. Nobody expected a mega storm on distant Neptune to just… vanish.
